stage: Independent semantic review of separate actual-file HTTP journey; not part of frozen natural 40
review_method: Read original actor, every delivered plan/question/card, successful receipts, corrections/errors, final host answer and instrumented evaluator source. Recomputed actual receipt bytes SHA/size and matched exact proposal/approval/dispatch parameters. Did not rerun or modify actor/source/oracle.

automatic_functional_checks_original.interpretation: Functional chain only, not a business-route completeness score.

independent_verdicts.overall: Functional actual-file and local-public-form chain is supported. The ambiguous physical/public route is not established as correct physical service triage and must not be counted as such. No definite new product bug is established solely from the actor ambiguity.

actor_design_assessment.deviation: The delegated extra scenario was intended to concern service-hall queue handling. The immutable actor instead describes an overflowing physical container, so it is not clean evidence for the intended service-handling complaint scenario.
actor_design_assessment.why_public_form_is_defensible: The actor explicitly asks to make a complaint and supplies a requested title, contact details and a test image. A public complaint interpretation is plausible; there is no explicit physical-service tool or operation instruction in the user utterance.
actor_design_assessment.why_route_not_proven: The underlying goal concerns a physical overflowing bin and the draft asks for emptying and cleaning. Ordinary citizens also call physical service requests complaints. No intent clarification is delivered before the public form route; the scripted actor only approves matching payload facts and cannot demonstrate a human made a conscious alternative-service selection.
actor_design_assessment.fairness: A model that instead asks whether a physical issue report or general complaint is desired, or asks for city/location for a physical path, would be handling a genuine ambiguity; that should not fail this actor as a model bug. Likewise public-form execution alone should not be called accurate physical issue classification.
actor_design_assessment.future_coverage: Keep this immutable result. A separately designed natural scenario with an unambiguous service-handling complaint can test the intended path, or a resident actor can answer a genuine intent question without tool/API wording. Do not selectively rewrite or replace this run.

independent_byte_verification.test_image_content_note: This is a 68-byte synthetic PNG. No visual inspection/scene understanding by the model is established. The upload memo labels the issue from conversation context; it must not be reported as verified image content or proof of an overflowing bin.

business_parameters.description_assessment: Preserves container/place/three-day context and drafts an understandable requested cleanup action. This is requested action text, not an assertion that cleanup occurred.
business_parameters.location_assessment: The form contains no city/coordinates because the executed path is an unclassified public form. That does not establish a valid physical municipal service request or successful geocoding.

model_payload_audit.evidence_limit: The evaluator attaches an onPayload check before forwarding every FAQ/sentiment/primary/verifier payload, tests the selected exact base64 string and stores only SHA plus boolean. Original raw payloads are not persisted here, so absence cannot be independently recomputed from retained hashes; this is source-inspected instrumentation evidence, not an additional network capture. No vision understanding is shown.
